topic: Anti-glare coating explained: fewer reflections, clearer night driving and screens

youtube.title: Anti-glare coating: myth vs fact ✨ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Headlights look like stars? Anti-glare coating: myth vs fact. ✨
ஆன்டி-கிளேர் கோட்டிங் பற்றிய உண்மை.

• Myth: anti-glare is only for computer users. Fact: plain lenses bounce light off both surfaces; the coating cuts those reflections for screens, night driving and photos.
• Myth: it's just a tint. Fact: it's a clear, thin multi-layer coating, so people see your eyes, not reflections.
• Care: rinse first, then wipe with a microfibre cloth. No hot water, no saree or shirt edge.
